title: ranunculus acris subsp. atlanticus
intro: Ranunculus acris subsp. atlanticus, commonly known as the Atlantic buttercup, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus acris subsp. atlanticus include its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isocumarins, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
